run_plot_vision_cli: run the plot_vision CLI with --blocks flag to visualize Minecraft block data from a binary file
run_plot_vision_with_depth: run plot_vision with --blocks and --depth flags to visualize block IDs and depth maps together
run_plot_vision_with_img: run plot_vision with --blocks and --img flags to overlay an image alongside block and depth data
run_plot_vision_visdom: run plot_vision with --visdom flag to render the visualization in a Visdom server instead of matplotlib
run_plot_vision_save: run plot_vision with --out_path flag to save the generated visualization plot to a file
